name: pacioli
description: Did your AI actually do what it said? Pacioli checks your agent's claims against the evidence and prints a receipt you can trust. Live demo.

paragraphs: Double-entry bookkeeping for AI agents. Pacioli reconciles what an agent claimed it did — booked, bought, subscribed — against what the evidence shows, and prints a receipt when the two don't reconcile.

Spend trackers show you what was charged. Pacioli reconciles it against what you authorized — deterministically, with a source citation on every finding — and abstains out loud on the calls a rule cannot make.

Live demo → pacioliapp.vercel.app — paste a claim + a confirmation, get the receipt. /methods is the per-class eval · /ledger is the live record → reconcile → review loop (forward a confirmation, watch it file into your own receipt ledger) plus real, source-cited failures as receipts · or run it locally in 30 seconds (below).
